definitions.full: H6965. qum קָמָי לֵב probably late Atbash (compare שֵׁשַׁךְ ) for p. 1058 כשׂדים the orginal reading ( ᵐ5 ) Jer 51:1 . קוּם 628 verb arise, stand up, stand ; — (Late Hebrew in derived species and derivatives; Phoenician Hiph`il Participle and מקם place ; Arabic stand, rise , Ethiopic stand, stop ; Sabean מקם , place , Hom Chrest. 127 ; Aramaic קוּם , = Biblical Hebrew, so Old Aramaic Nabataean קום ; Palmyrene Aph`el אקים erect statue ; compare probably Assyrian kumu ( k = כ ), place, dwelling , kum, kêmu , in place of , and perhaps kaiamânu , enduring, constant (see כִּיּוּן ); Thes compare also Samaritan image unavailable , live , compare especially ᵑ7 Pa`el); — Qal 460 Perfect 3masculine singular קָם 1Sam 17:48 +, וְקָאם consecutive Hosea 10:14 (Ges § 72p ); 2 masculine singular קַמְתָּ 2Sam 12:21 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יָקוּם Exod 21:19 , jussive יָקֻם Gen 27:31 , (לָ֑ךְׅ וְיָ֫קָם Job 22:28 (Ges § 109h Dr § 152 (3)); וַיָּ֫קָם Gen 4:8 +, etc.; Imperative masculine singular קוּם 13:17 +, feminine plural קֹמְנָה Isa 32:9 , etc.; Infinitive absolute קוֺם Jer 44:29 ; construct קָוּם Amos 5:2 +, etc.; Participle> feminine singular קָמָה Micah 7:6 ; masculine plural קָמִים 2Sam 18:31 +, הַקּוֺמִים 2Kin 16:17 (Ges § 72p ), etc.; — 1 arise: מִתַּחְתָּיו Exod 10:23 (E). Specifically: a. after lying down (sleep, sickness, mourning, etc.), 1Sam 3:6 , 8 ; 2Sam 12:21 ; Exod 21:19 ; Gen 19:33 , 35 ; 31:17 ; Ruth 3:14 ; Eccl 12:4 50t.; from lying dead, עַלרַֿגְלָיו קַיָּקָם 2Kin 13:21 , compare Job 14:12 ; Isa 26:14 , 19 ; Psa 88:11 ; after falling Amos 5:2 ; 8:14 ; Jer 8:4 ; 25:27 4 t. (chiefly figurative); after being smitten, wounded, etc. Psa 18:39 || 2Sam 22:39 ; Isa 27:9 (of Asherim, etc.), 43:17 4 t.; from sitting, reclining, especially at meals Gen 25:34 ; 1Sam 1:9 ; 20:34 ( הַשֻּׁלְחָן מֵעִם ; 20:25 see קָדַם ), Est 7:7 ( + אֶל in construction Praegn.), but also Judg 3:20 ( מֵעַל ), 2Sam 2:14 (twice in verse); 2:15 , Jonah 3:6 ( מִכִּסְאוֺ ), + 11 t., + ( arise = stand up, in respect), Gen 19:1 ( + לִקְתָאתָם ), 31:35 ( מִמָּנֶיךָ ), Lev 19:32 ( מִמְּנֵי ), Isa 49:7 ;
